entries.intent: Show whether an operator at the console can reboot the box with Ctrl-Alt-Delete

7.notes: RHEL 7 wants the target both masked and inactive; the pinned V3R15 check treats an active target as a finding on its own.

8.notes: The RHEL 8 check reads the same unit status and looks for "Loaded: masked".

9.notes: Same read on RHEL 9. The pinned V2R9 fix uses disable --now and mask --now, which the RHEL 8 fix text does not.

10.notes: Same read on RHEL 10 under the pinned V1R2 benchmark.

entries.verify: The unit block reports Loaded: masked and Active: inactive (dead).
entries.undo: Nothing to undo — this command only reads unit state and changes nothing on the host.

stig.fix_cmd: systemctl disable ctrl-alt-del.target && systemctl mask ctrl-alt-del.target
sudo systemctl disable ctrl-alt-del.target && sudo systemctl mask ctrl-alt-del.target
sudo systemctl disable --now ctrl-alt-del.target && sudo systemctl mask --now ctrl-alt-del.target
sudo systemctl disable --now ctrl-alt-del.target && sudo systemctl mask --now ctrl-alt-del.target
